pick.headline: Clashes in Warsaw on the May 3 anniversary under martial law
pick.fbis: The Eastern Europe Daily Report of May 4, 1982, listed under Poland Warsaw media on the May 3 demonstrations in Warsaw and other cities, damage and detentions, and foreign reports including AFP on police charging a rally.

alternates.headline: Conservatives win the British election; Thatcher to become prime minister
alternates.fbis: The Eastern Europe Daily Report of May 7, 1979, listed Czechoslovak reportage on the election of the Thatcher government and the Conservative victory, and a GDR commentary on the Conservative victory in Britain.
